title: the leak
hook: your group chat just leaked to the whole grade. the worst message has your name on it.
setting: Sophomore year, a Tuesday at lunch, a high school in Southern California.
tone: tense, twisty, a whodunit in the group chat

self.description: Fifteen, in a group chat of six that was supposed to be private.
self.want: To clear your name before sixth period.

cast.name: Zoe
cast.relationshipType: your friend in the group chat
cast.description: The funniest one, the meanest one, has your old phone.
cast.avoids: Admitting she used your old phone.

cast.name: Sofia
cast.relationshipType: the girl the message was about
cast.description: Quiet, kind, the last person who deserved it.
cast.want: To know who actually said it.
cast.tension: you've never been mean to her, until now

opening.title: The chat
opening.description: Six of you, a group chat called "no adults", two years of it.

opening.title: The old phone
opening.description: Last month you gave Zoe your old phone, still logged in.

opening.title: Lunch
opening.description: At 12:10 a screenshot goes round the grade: a cruel message about Sofia, from you.

background: Zoe typed it from your old phone as a joke and screenshotted it to one person.
